reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A malformed document identifier is supplied. `revision_changed`: The source record changed between continuation calls. `unknown_section`: A selected document section is unrecognized. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: The status response contradicts the requested document ID. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Present payload violates the wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: The source remains unavailable after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: The process upstream queue is full. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
